label: GPT-6.1 Sol (Agency native)
explanation: Unedited math tests revealed pervasive recursive reconsideration and non-completion in thinking mode; non-thinking counterfactuals completed and correctly solved substantially more problems. The adapter uses two analytical rank-one updates: a layer-23 MLP output transfer from boxed-math initial thinking states to successful end-of-thinking states, gated by a nullspace-projected input direction; and a layer-16 attenuation of the concentrated wait/reconsider feature, with ordinary language and coding activations protected by nullspace projection. Separate unedited feature checks showed strong activation at held-out boxed-math thinking starts and weak activation on ordinary and non-thinking starts. Both updates satisfy the rank and norm limits. No edited model was generated or evaluated, and no gradients or iterative loss fitting were used.
